_source: Principality of Stone Codex p.6 'Half-ruined Keep Outpost'. Rogue's Path: ignore sections tied to story / Kingdom map / Vision / Delve (Scouts' Guild, Notice Board, Inn results 6, 10). Only the first section used grants its Early Bird effect (rulebook p.28).
name: Half-ruined Keep Outpost

earlyBird.text: Add 1 random level 2 Mercenary card to the Mercenary deck. Remove that card from Mercenary deck at the end of the Outpost phase.
earlyBird.devil: You may add 1 random level 3 Mercenary card instead.

mercenaryGuild.text: The Mercenary deck consists of all level 1 Mercenary cards, the Ruin Stalker card, and all additional Mercenary cards you've unlocked. Hired help: From the Mercenary deck the Party may hire up to 4 Mercenaries for this Expedition. At the end of the Expedition, return those cards to the Mercenary deck.

earlyBird.text: Instead of rolling for an effect, you may choose an effect.

inn.text: You may roll a d10 and resolve the corresponding effect:

1.text: Two random Knights gain +1 to any Virtue for the duration of this Expedition.

2.text: Two random Knights raise their Heat Limit by 1.

4.text: A random Knight gains +1 [Passion] and, for the duration of this Expedition, their [Passion] cannot fall below 1.

5.text: Draw a Loot card. Each Knight gains X Gold, where X is the Gold denoted on that card for their tier. Return that card to the Scavenge deck.

6.text: Reveal one connected Kingdom tile, mark it with a Generic token as Unexplored.

8.text: A random Knight raises their Bane Limit by 1 for the duration of this Expedition.

9.text: Place a chosen Resource token on the chosen Knight's Board or in the Knight Pool.

10.text: One Knight gains the Parasite Bait Kingdom card for the duration of this Expedition.
10.roguesPath: ignore? [확인: Parasite Bait Kingdom Gear 카드 자료 없음]

scoutsGuild.text: Recon / Patrol / Survey — Kingdom exploration only.

earlyBird.text: Add a random Consumable card of your tier to the Merchant deck. Remove that card from Merchant deck at the end of the Outpost phase.

merchantsWorkshop.text: Merchant deck consists of all Merchant cards of your tier and tiers below, and all unlocked Consumable cards. You may buy any Gear cards from Merchant deck. You may reforge any owned Merchant Gear. You may spend 5 Gold to buy 1 Stone Key.

shrineOfTheSaints.text: Any Knight with at least 1 Devotion token may discard 1 Devotion token to gain a chosen unlocked Saint's card.
shrineOfTheSaints.roguesPath: use only if a Saint is unlocked via Rosegraal Wild Card

noticeBoard.text: The Party may sign a Contract.
